title: Event, one execution, one error or one alert of a command, a script, a step or a project
description: One schema for the execution-time ledger (kind exec: brain timed, brain.timing.timed; read by brain perf), the ops error events (kind error: wi-ops-error-catalog) and the project alerts (kind alert: brain alerts raise | resolve, brain.alerts.emit; read by brain alerts and brain status), so they make one stream. Append-only: one JSON object per line, in $BRAIN_HOME/ledger/<kind>-<yyyy-mm>.jsonl by the month of 'at', or in a project's own events store (projects.yaml alerts: events:).

kind.description: exec: a run with its duration; error: a finding of a detector or a watchdog; alert: an alert opened or resolved, folded by its key (the last event of a key says whether it is open).

at.description: When it happened (UTC); an exec event's end.

host.description: The machine ($BRAIN_HOST, else the host name).

project.description: A project of the Brain's registry (brain, acme...), else the repo's folder name.

task.description: The step: a name the caller gives (cycle L4), else the command line or module.function; alert: what it is about (a task, a stack, a data source).

version.description: What ran: the caller's version, else the short SHA of HEAD of the repo it ran in.

details.description: Free details of the project (counts, inputs, a message).

duration_s.description: exec: seconds, from a monotonic clock (not end - start).

exit.description: exec: the exit code (0: success; a Python exception: 1, KeyboardInterrupt: 130; a POSIX signal: its negative number); null when unknown.

error.description: exec: why it did not finish normally (the exception's type, not found, interrupted).

command.description: exec: the command line (lines matching a secret pattern dropped).

pid.description: The process that wrote the event.

code.description: error: the catalogued code (an exit code, a scheduler result, a name).

severity.description: error and alert: how grave it is; an alert is sent through brain notify at this level.

key.description: alert: its stable id within the project (freshness:returns_matic, task:acme-snapshot:missed); every event of one alert has the same key.

state.description: alert: opened (or still open, at a new level or message) or resolved.

source.description: alert: who raised it (a watchdog, a CLI, a monitor; the Brain's own: scheduler, ledger, stack, code-index, audit, file, events).

message.description: alert: what is wrong, in one line (lines matching a secret pattern dropped).

link.description: alert: a URL or a path to look at.
